more_info.overview: Sorbitan trioleate is an ester preparation also known as Span 85 or anhydrosorbitol trioleate. Its defined structure contains a sorbitan-derived component and three oleate ester groups. The chemical record describes it as a surface-active or emulsifying ingredient. This historical entry does not establish a current direct human-food application, and properties of other sorbitan esters cannot supply an intake limit for it.
